title: VerdictArtifact
description: Structured provenance for a kernel verdict. SPECIFICATION ONLY — shipping this schema does NOT mean provenance is implemented end-to-end. Epistemic rule: fields under accepted_inputs record what the kernel ASSUMED for this verdict, not verified world truth. asserted_by ≠ verified_truth; provenance_ref ≠ truth; accepted_input ≠ world_fact.

decision_id.description: Stable identifier for this verdict instance (UUID or content hash).

verdict.description: Final kernel verdict. Same enum as decision.schema.json.

kernel_version.description: Version of the decision kernel that produced this artifact.

constitution_version.description: Frozen axiom set identifier (e.g. fdk-v1.0-a1-a7). NOT a claim that the constitution is morally correct.

accepted_inputs.description: Facts the kernel treated as given for this verdict. Each entry is an ASSUMPTION, not verified truth.

constitutional_basis.description: Which frozen axioms grounded this verdict.

inference_trace.description: Ordered rule IDs applied during inference. rule_id refers to registry entries, not implicit code order.

authority_context_ref.description: Optional reference to authority grant / capability context (Track A). Null when verdict is moral-only or pre-authority.

action_ref.description: Binds verdict to the action content (nonce or hash). Aligns with decision.schema.json action_ref.

input_hash.description: Hash of the normalized input bundle used for this verdict (reproducibility).

signature.description: Optional Ed25519 (or other) signature over canonical artifact bytes. Null in specification-only / pre-implementation artifacts.

epistemic_disclaimer.const: This artifact records constitutional behavior conditional on accepted_inputs. It does not certify that accepted inputs match world truth.
epistemic_disclaimer.description: Mandatory disclaimer — parsers MUST preserve this field.

fact_value.description: Value assumed for this verdict. Typed per fact_key registry.

asserted_by.description: WHO supplied this fact (principal, plugin, caller). asserted_by ≠ verified_truth.

input_class.description: How the fact entered the kernel. ATTESTED does not mean morally true — only that an attestation chain exists (when implemented).

provenance_ref.description: Optional URI/hash to attestation log or source record. provenance_ref ≠ truth.

accepted_at.description: When the kernel accepted this input for this verdict.

axiom_ids.description: Frozen axiom IDs from AXIOM_REGISTRY (e.g. A4, C1). References normative layer, not moral proof.

derived_principle_ids.description: Optional derived principle IDs (C1–C7) when distinct from axiom_ids.

rule_ids.description: Ordered list of calculus rules fired. Must map to AXIOM_REGISTRY / code registry when implemented.

defer_reason.description: When verdict=DEFER, why inference could not complete.
